details: 4 website types: Landing Page, Business Website, Ecommerce, Web App
Conditional platform options based on type
Landing Page: WordPress, Wix, Webflow, Framer, AI Builder, Custom Code
Ecommerce: Shopify, Wix, WooCommerce
Web App: AI Builder, Custom Code
Selection preview shows 'Creating: [Platform] [Type]'
Landing Page: Content (Business Name, Tagline, About Text, CTA Text), Contact (Contact Info, Social Links)
Business Website: Business Info, Content (Services, Team, Testimonials), Contact
Ecommerce: Store Info (Store Name, Categories, Products Count), Collections, Policies
Web App: App Info, Technical (User Roles, Integrations, Tech Stack), Auth & API
Logo & Assets: Logo URL, Favicon URL
Color Palette: Primary, Secondary, Accent colors with color pickers
Typography & Guidelines: Primary Font, Secondary Font, Brand Guidelines URL
Basic tab: Project Name, Domain URL, Onboarding Date, Deadline, Notes
Client tab: Client Name, Location, Email, Phone
Credentials tab: Domain Username/Password, WP Username/Password
Team tab: Developer, Designer, Content Writer, Project Manager dropdowns
Links tab: Google Drive URL, Documents URL, Communication Channel
Available on Step 2 and Step 3
Skips directly to Step 4 (Details)
Back button available on all steps
Navigates to previous step correctly
Shows 4 steps: Type, Requirements, Branding, Details
Completed steps show checkmark
Current step highlighted
POST /api/website-projects/projects accepts all fields
requirements field accepts Dict with dynamic fields
branding field accepts Dict with colors, fonts, URLs
Project created successfully with toast notification
